welcome.title: Enter the experience.
welcome.description: Headphones recommended. Turn on audio for a more immersive experience.

intro.title: Introduction Mark VII
intro.description: The Mark VII is Tony Stark's seventh Iron Man armor. Built for heavy combat, it features a fully automated deployment system that allows Tony to summon and assemble the suit in seconds.

helmet.title: Helmet & HUD
helmet.description: The helmet houses Tony's heads-up display, advanced targeting system, and onboard diagnostics. Its sensors provide real-time tactical data, helping him identify threats and navigate combat situations.

chest.title: Arc Reactor
chest.description: The triangular chest-mounted arc reactor supplies power to the armor. It is the core of Tony's technology, supporting the suit's flight systems, weapons, and life-support functions.

hand.title: Repulsors
hand.description: Integrated into the palms, repulsors fire concentrated energy blasts capable of striking targets with precision. They also provide directional thrust, allowing Tony to maneuver during flight.

boots.title: Boot Thrusters
boots.description: Powerful thrusters built into the boots generate the thrust needed for flight. Combined with the hand repulsors, they allow Tony to accelerate, hover, and control his direction in mid-air.

ergonomic.title: Armor Design
ergonomic.description: The Mark VII uses a complex assembly of interlocking armor plates and mechanical components. Its articulated construction protects Tony while preserving the mobility needed for close-quarters combat and flight.

summary.title: Mark VII
summary.description: The Iron Man Mark VII combines advanced engineering, powerful repulsor technology, a high-output arc reactor, and an autonomous flight system. Its modular armor and rapid deployment technology make it one of Tony Stark's most versatile combat suits, balancing protection, mobility, and offensive power.

footer.label: Iron Man — Mark VII
footer.title: The next evolution
footer.description: A closer look at Tony Stark's Mark VII — exploring its engineering, design, weapon systems, and advanced flight capabilities.

project.label: Project
project.description: An interactive 3D experience dedicated to one of the most iconic Iron Man armors from Marvel's The Avengers (2012).
